payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: the agent catalog's artifact-index projection silently returns nothing against the flipped core. src/sase/agents/catalog/_sources.py (load_artifact_index_projection) rejects the index unless meta.schema_version == AGENT_ARTIFACT_INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION (still 34 in src/sase/core/agent_scan_wire_records.py:29). sase-core 75e27f9 writes 35, and 650c313b71 (sase-1ab.10.3) widened only SUPPORTED_AGENT_ARTIFACT_INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSIONS to {33,34,35}; this reader was not moved onto the SUPPORTED set. Repro on apollo 2026-09-28: ~/.sase/agent_artifact_index.sqlite meta schema_version=35; python -c 'from sase.agents.catalog._sources import load_artifact_index_projection as f; print(len(f()))' -> 0; sase agent search '' -l 0 -j shows 709/1456 rows with from_artifact_index=false and from_dismissed_archive=false, covering all 667 done and 34 active rows (status/model/started_at null). Impact: the Artifacts Agent pane and sase agent search show every non-dismissed agent as a thin 'no run data' row, and status/model/provider/time filters miss them. Fix: check membership in SUPPORTED_AGENT_ARTIFACT_INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSIONS (or source the version from the binding) and add a regression that stamps the index at the flipped version. Found by research consolidation research:202609/agent_history_in_agents_tab/agent_history_in_agents_tab.md (section 3.1).
